summary: The document provides an implementation of a binary search algorithm in JavaScript, which includes sorting functionality to prepare the data for binary searching.
purpose: To implement a binary search function that efficiently locates the position of an item in a sorted array.

workflows.name: Binary Search Workflow
steps: Sort the array numerically using the numeric_sort function.
Invoke BinarySearch with the desired search item, the start and end positions, and the array.
Check if the start position equals the end position; if so, verify if the item at startPos is the searchItem.
If the start position is greater than the end position, return -1 indicating the item is not found.
Calculate the midpoint and compare the search item with the item at the midpoint.
If they match, return the midpoint position.
If the search item is less, recursively search in the left sub-array.
If the search item is more, recursively search in the right sub-array.

system_behavior: The function returns the index of the search item if found; otherwise, it returns -1.
